ordered_diagnoses: Breast cancer with cutaneous lymphatic invasion

s1.syndrome_frame: Postoperative skin lesion with erythema and nodules
salient_findings: Pruritic erythema lesion with multiple nodules over the operation site of the right breast
Well-demarcated, warm, erythematous plaque over the right side of the anterior chest wall
Multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels
key_facts: History of right breast cancer, stage IIIa (cT2N2M0)
Underwent neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by right modified radical mastectomy and postoperative radiotherapy
Noticed skin lesion after radiotherapy
Lesion did not respond to initial topical treatments
Presentation to dermatology 1 year after initial cancer diagnosis
Erythematous plaque measured 15 × 12 cm
Multiple palpable small nodules within the erythema
Immunohistochemistry negative for ER, PR, and HER2
Skin biopsy showed multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels
